steps.message:
# RL training run diagnosis

Review the staged post-training experiment and determine whether it is healthy
or unhealthy. Treat the workspace as a historical snapshot: inspect its source,
effective configuration, launch scripts, data processing, reward logic, logs,
tracked metrics, and frozen evaluation evidence. Do not assume that an unusual
setting or implementation is causal without connecting it to observed behavior.

Use held-out evaluation evidence together with rollout, truncation, runtime,
optimization, and training signals. Training reward alone does not establish
held-out health. A truncated log is not by itself proof of a defect.

Do not launch a full training run, use the network, or modify the historical
snapshot. The dataset, held-out set, model, training-step budget, and evaluation
interval are fixed.

## Deliverable

Write one concise UTF-8 diagnosis to:

```text
$AUTORLBENCH_RESULTS/agent_answer.md
```

State the verdict, identify the concrete root cause or causes, and explain the
causal chain using specific workspace evidence. Distinguish root causes from
symptoms. Do not propose or implement a fix, and do not write other deliverable
files.

I’ll trace the effective run configuration through rollout generation, reward computation, and optimization, then reconcile those mechanisms with the logged and frozen held-out evidence before writing the diagnosis.

1	#!/usr/bin/env bash
2	# GRPO | Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct | GSM8K train 7,473 / GSM8K test 1,319 held-out | FSDP + vLLM | 1 GPU
3	#
4	# verl GSM8K GRPO quickstart recipe, scaled to one GPU, with the MATH-style prompt from
5	# examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k_boxed.py ('... output the final answer within \\boxed{}.'). The reward
6	# is Math-Verify through verl's built-in scorer (rewards/math_verify_reward.py, wired in with
7	# reward.custom_reward_function); verl uses the same function for the held-out metric
8	# val-core/openai/gsm8k/acc/mean@1 on the full GSM8K test split (greedy).
9	#
10	# trainer.use_v1=False selects the verl/trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py loop; the v1 trainer needs
11	# the optional TransferQueue package, which is not installed.
12	#
13	# Everything the run writes goes to $LOG_DIR:
14	#   train.log                       full stdout/stderr of the trainer
15	#   metrics.jsonl                   one JSON line per training step (verl file logger)
16	#   wandb/                          offline W&B run
17	#   rollouts/<step>.jsonl           training rollouts (prompt, response, score) per step
18	#   val_generations/<step>.jsonl    held-out generations at each evaluation
19	#   rollouts/ and val_generations/ carry the score the reward assigned to each response.
20	
21	set -xeuo pipefail
22	
23	W=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
24	cd "$W"
25	
26	# ---- user-adjustable ----
27	MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-$W/models/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct}
28	TRAIN_FILE=${TRAIN_FILE:-$W/data/gsm8k_boxed/train.parquet}
29	VAL_FILE=${VAL_FILE:-$W/data/gsm8k_boxed/test.parquet}
30	LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-$W/outputs/run}
31	NGPUS_PER_NODE=${NGPUS_PER_NODE:-1}
32	
33	TOTAL_STEPS=${TOTAL_STEPS:-100}
34	TEST_FREQ=${TEST_FREQ:-10}
35	SEED=${SEED:-42}
36	
37	TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE=128         # prompts per step
38	ROLLOUT_N=8                  # responses per prompt (GRPO group size)
39	PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE=4        # smaller mini-batches to fit memory
40	MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH=512
41	MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH=512
42	
43	ACTOR_LR=2e-6
44	KL_LOSS_COEF=0.001
45	
46	PROJECT_NAME=${PROJECT_NAME:-grpo_gsm8k}
47	EXPERIMENT_NAME=${EXPERIMENT_NAME:-qwen2_5_0_5b_gsm8k_boxed_grpo}
48	# ---- end user-adjustable ----
49	
50	if [ ! -f "$MODEL_PATH/config.json" ]; then
51	    echo "model not found at $MODEL_PATH" >&2; exit 1
52	fi
53	if [ ! -f "$TRAIN_FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$VAL_FILE" ]; then
54	    python3 examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k_boxed.py --local_dataset_path "$W/data/raw/gsm8k" --local_save_dir "$(dirname "$TRAIN_FILE")"
55	fi
56	
57	mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
58	export PYTHONPATH="$W${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
59	export WANDB_MODE=${WANDB_MODE:-offline}
60	export WANDB_DIR=${WANDB_DIR:-$LOG_DIR}
61	export VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH="$LOG_DIR/metrics.jsonl"
62	export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false
63	
64	DATA=(
65	    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo
66	    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False
67	    data.train_files="$TRAIN_FILE"
68	    data.val_files="$VAL_FILE"
69	    data.train_batch_size=$TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE
70	    data.max_prompt_length=$MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH
71	    data.max_response_length=$MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH
72	    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True
73	    data.truncation=error
74	    data.seed=$SEED
75	)
76	
77	MODEL=(
78	    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$MODEL_PATH"
79	    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True
80	    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True
81	)
82	
83	ACTOR=(
84	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=$ACTOR_LR
85	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=$PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE
86	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True
87	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
88	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=True
89	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=$KL_LOSS_COEF
90	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl
91	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0
92	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=token-mean
93	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.data_loader_seed=$SEED
94	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=False
95	    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=False
96	)
97	
98	ROLLOUT=(
99	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm
100	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1
101	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.4
102	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=$ROLLOUT_N
103	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0
104	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_p=1.0
105	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_k=-1
106	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.seed=$SEED
107	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True
108	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
109	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1
110	    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.do_sample=False
111	    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True
112	    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
113	)
114	
115	REWARD=(
116	    reward.custom_reward_function.path="$W/rewards/math_verify_reward.py"
117	    reward.custom_reward_function.name=compute_score
118	)
119	
120	TRAINER=(

#!/usr/bin/env bash
# GRPO | Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct | GSM8K train 7,473 / GSM8K test 1,319 held-out | FSDP + vLLM | 1 GPU
#
# verl GSM8K GRPO quickstart recipe, scaled to one GPU, with the MATH-style prompt from
# examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k_boxed.py ('... output the final answer within \\boxed{}.'). The reward
# is Math-Verify through verl's built-in scorer (rewards/math_verify_reward.py, wired in with
# reward.custom_reward_function); verl uses the same function for the held-out metric
# val-core/openai/gsm8k/acc/mean@1 on the full GSM8K test split (greedy).
#
# trainer.use_v1=False selects the verl/trainer/ppo/ray_trainer.py loop; the v1 trainer needs
# the optional TransferQueue package, which is not installed.
#
# Everything the run writes goes to $LOG_DIR:
#   train.log                       full stdout/stderr of the trainer
#   metrics.jsonl                   one JSON line per training step (verl file logger)
#   wandb/                          offline W&B run
#   rollouts/<step>.jsonl           training rollouts (prompt, response, score) per step
#   val_generations/<step>.jsonl    held-out generations at each evaluation
#   rollouts/ and val_generations/ carry the score the reward assigned to each response.

set -xeuo pipefail

W=$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")" && pwd)
cd "$W"

# ---- user-adjustable ----
MODEL_PATH=${MODEL_PATH:-$W/models/Qwen2.5-0.5B-Instruct}
TRAIN_FILE=${TRAIN_FILE:-$W/data/gsm8k_boxed/train.parquet}
VAL_FILE=${VAL_FILE:-$W/data/gsm8k_boxed/test.parquet}
LOG_DIR=${LOG_DIR:-$W/outputs/run}
NGPUS_PER_NODE=${NGPUS_PER_NODE:-1}

TOTAL_STEPS=${TOTAL_STEPS:-100}
TEST_FREQ=${TEST_FREQ:-10}
SEED=${SEED:-42}

TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE=128         # prompts per step
ROLLOUT_N=8                  # responses per prompt (GRPO group size)
PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE=4        # smaller mini-batches to fit memory
MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH=512
MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH=512

ACTOR_LR=2e-6
KL_LOSS_COEF=0.001

PROJECT_NAME=${PROJECT_NAME:-grpo_gsm8k}
EXPERIMENT_NAME=${EXPERIMENT_NAME:-qwen2_5_0_5b_gsm8k_boxed_grpo}
# ---- end user-adjustable ----

if [ ! -f "$MODEL_PATH/config.json" ]; then
    echo "model not found at $MODEL_PATH" >&2; exit 1
fi
if [ ! -f "$TRAIN_FILE" ] || [ ! -f "$VAL_FILE" ]; then
    python3 examples/data_preprocess/gsm8k_boxed.py --local_dataset_path "$W/data/raw/gsm8k" --local_save_dir "$(dirname "$TRAIN_FILE")"
fi

mkdir -p "$LOG_DIR"
export PYTHONPATH="$W${PYTHONPATH:+:$PYTHONPATH}"
export WANDB_MODE=${WANDB_MODE:-offline}
export WANDB_DIR=${WANDB_DIR:-$LOG_DIR}
export VERL_FILE_LOGGER_PATH="$LOG_DIR/metrics.jsonl"
export TOKENIZERS_PARALLELISM=false

DATA=(
    algorithm.adv_estimator=grpo
    algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=False
    data.train_files="$TRAIN_FILE"
    data.val_files="$VAL_FILE"
    data.train_batch_size=$TRAIN_BATCH_SIZE
    data.max_prompt_length=$MAX_PROMPT_LENGTH
    data.max_response_length=$MAX_RESPONSE_LENGTH
    data.filter_overlong_prompts=True
    data.truncation=error
    data.seed=$SEED
)

MODEL=(
    actor_rollout_ref.model.path="$MODEL_PATH"
    actor_rollout_ref.model.use_remove_padding=True
    actor_rollout_ref.model.enable_gradient_checkpointing=True
)

ACTOR=(
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.optim.lr=$ACTOR_LR
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_mini_batch_size=$PPO_MINI_BATCH_SIZE
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.ppo_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.use_kl_loss=True
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_coef=$KL_LOSS_COEF
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.kl_loss_type=low_var_kl
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.entropy_coeff=0
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.loss_agg_mode=token-mean
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.data_loader_seed=$SEED
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.param_offload=False
    actor_rollout_ref.actor.fsdp_config.optimizer_offload=False
)

ROLLOUT=(
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.name=vllm
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.tensor_model_parallel_size=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.gpu_memory_utilization=0.4
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.n=$ROLLOUT_N
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.temperature=1.0
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_p=1.0
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.top_k=-1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.seed=$SEED
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.n=1
    actor_rollout_ref.rollout.val_kwargs.do_sample=False
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_use_dynamic_bsz=True
    actor_rollout_ref.ref.log_prob_max_token_len_per_gpu=24576
)

REWARD=(
    reward.custom_reward_function.path="$W/rewards/math_verify_reward.py"
    reward.custom_reward_function.name=compute_score
)

TRAINER=(
    trainer.use_v1=False
    trainer.critic_warmup=0
    trainer.logger='["console","wandb","file"]'
    trainer.project_name=$PROJECT_NAME
    trainer.experiment_name=$EXPERIMENT_NAME
    trainer.n_gpus_per_node=$NGPUS_PER_NODE
    trainer.nnodes=1
    trainer.val_before_train=True
    trainer.test_freq=$TEST_FREQ
    trainer.save_freq=-1
    trainer.total_epochs=100
    trainer.total_training_steps=$TOTAL_STEPS
    trainer.rollout_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/rollouts"
    trainer.validation_data_dir="$LOG_DIR/val_generations"
    trainer.default_local_dir="$LOG_DIR/checkpoints"
)

python3 -m verl.trainer.main_ppo \
    "${DATA[@]}" \
    "${MODEL[@]}" \
    "${ACTOR[@]}" \
    "${ROLLOUT[@]}" \
    "${REWARD[@]}" \
    "${TRAINER[@]}" \
    "$@" 2>&1 | tee "$LOG_DIR/train.log"

"""
Preprocess the GSM8k dataset to parquet format
"""

import argparse
import os
import re

import datasets

from verl.utils.hdfs_io import copy, makedirs


def extract_solution(solution_str):
    solution = re.search("#### (\\-?[0-9\\.\\,]+)", solution_str)
    assert solution is not None
    final_solution = solution.group(0)
    final_solution = final_solution.split("#### ")[1].replace(",", "")
    return final_solution


if __name__ == "__main__":
    parser = argparse.ArgumentParser()
    parser.add_argument("--local_dir", default=None, help="The save directory for the preprocessed dataset.")
    parser.add_argument("--hdfs_dir", default=None)
    parser.add_argument("--local_dataset_path", default=None, help="The local path to the raw dataset, if it exists.")
    parser.add_argument(
        "--local_save_dir", default="~/data/gsm8k", help="The save directory for the preprocessed dataset."
    )

    args = parser.parse_args()
    local_dataset_path = args.local_dataset_path

    data_source = "openai/gsm8k"

    if local_dataset_path is not None:
        dataset = datasets.load_dataset(local_dataset_path, "main")
    else:
        dataset = datasets.load_dataset(data_source, "main")

    train_dataset = dataset["train"]
    test_dataset = dataset["test"]

    instruction_following = "Let's think step by step and output the final answer within \\boxed{}."

    # add a row to each data item that represents a unique id
    def make_map_fn(split):
        def process_fn(example, idx):
            question_raw = example.pop("question")

            question = question_raw + " " + instruction_following

            answer_raw = example.pop("answer")
            solution = extract_solution(answer_raw)
            data = {
                "data_source": data_source,
                "prompt": [
                    {
                        "role": "user",
                        "content": question,
                    }
                ],
                "ability": "math",
                "reward_model": {"style": "rule", "ground_truth": solution},
                "extra_info": {
                    "split": split,
                    "index": idx,
                    "answer": answer_raw,
                    "question": question_raw,
                },
            }
            return data

        return process_fn

    train_dataset = train_dataset.map(function=make_map_fn("train"), with_indices=True)
    test_dataset = test_dataset.map(function=make_map_fn("test"), with_indices=True)

    hdfs_dir = args.hdfs_dir
    local_save_dir = args.local_dir
    if local_save_dir is not None:
        print("Warning: Argument 'local_dir' is deprecated. Please use 'local_save_dir' instead.")
    else:
        local_save_dir = args.local_save_dir

    train_dataset.to_parquet(os.path.join(local_save_dir, "train.parquet"))
    test_dataset.to_parquet(os.path.join(local_save_dir, "test.parquet"))

    if hdfs_dir is not None:
        makedirs(hdfs_dir)

        copy(src=local_save_dir, dst=hdfs_dir)

"""Reward: Math-Verify equivalence between the response's final answer and the gold answer.

Thin wrapper around verl's built-in scorer ``verl.utils.reward_score.math_verify.compute_score``
(the one verl's ``default_compute_score`` comments suggest for MATH-style data). Wired in through
``reward.custom_reward_function.path/name`` (see run_gsm8k_grpo.sh); verl calls
``compute_score(data_source=..., solution_str=..., ground_truth=..., extra_info=...)`` from its
reward loop and uses the same function for the held-out validation metric.
"""

from verl.utils.reward_score import math_verify


def compute_score(data_source, solution_str, ground_truth, extra_info=None, **kwargs):
    if solution_str is None:
        return 0.0
    return float(math_verify.compute_score(solution_str, str(ground_truth)))

# Format checks enforced on CI:
# 1. Comments must appear above each field.
# 2. There must be a blank line between each field.
# 3. Inline comments (after a field on the same line) are not allowed.
# 4. Indentation level is respected for nested fields.

# specify the default per-component configs
defaults:

  - model_engine: dp

  # <folder_name>@<field_name>.<field_name>: <yaml_file_name>
  # actor_rollout_ref.actor: trainer/config/actor/dp_actor.yaml
  - actor@actor_rollout_ref.actor: ${model_engine}_actor

  # data: trainer/config/data/legacy_data.yaml
  - data@data: legacy_data

  # Reference model config.
  # Reference model will be enabled when actor.use_kl_loss or/and algorithm.use_kl_in_reward is/are True.
  - ref@actor_rollout_ref.ref: ${model_engine}_ref

  # Rollout model config.
  - rollout@actor_rollout_ref.rollout: rollout

  # Model config.
  - model@actor_rollout_ref.model: hf_model

  # Critic model config.
  - critic@critic: ${model_engine}_critic
  - model@critic.model: hf_model

  # legacy reward impl config, for backward compatibility
  - legacy_reward_impl

  # Reward config.
  - reward@reward: reward

  # Rollout correction config.
  - algorithm@algorithm.rollout_correction: rollout_correction

  # distillation config
  - distillation@distillation: distillation

  # TransferQueue configuration.
  - transfer_queue@transfer_queue: transfer_queue

  # load the reference default config, then apply the fields in the current yaml
  # self config override anything above
  - _self_

# config for actor, rollout and reference model
actor_rollout_ref:

  # Whether it's a hybrid engine, currently only supports hybrid engine
  hybrid_engine: true

  # Timeout for operations executed against the process group
  nccl_timeout: 600

# config for the algorithm
algorithm:

  # Required when using verl.utils.omega_conf_to_dataclass to instantiate dataclass configs
  _target_: verl.trainer.config.AlgoConfig

  # Discount factor for future rewards
  gamma: 1.0

  # Trade-off between bias and variance in the GAE estimator
  lam: 1.0

  # Advantage estimator type: "gae", "grpo", "reinforce_plus_plus", etc.
  adv_estimator: gae

  # Whether to normalize advantages by std (specific to GRPO)
  norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: True

  # Group filtering configuration used by DAPO and entropy-based sampling
  filter_groups:

    # Required when using verl.utils.omega_conf_to_dataclass to instantiate dataclass configs
    _target_: verl.trainer.config.FilterGroupsConfig

    # Whether to enable group filtering
    enable: False

    # Metric used to identify groups with uniform rewards, acc / score / seq_reward / seq_final_reward / ...
    metric: null

    # Maximum number of generation batches; non-positive values mean no upper limit
    max_num_gen_batches: 0

    # Maximum Sync DAPO prompt batches concurrently in flight, measured in train-batch units
    max_inflight_gen_batches: 1

  # Whether to enable in-reward KL penalty
  use_kl_in_reward: False

  # How to estimate KL divergence: "kl", "abs", "mse", "low_var_kl", or "full"
  kl_penalty: kl

  # KL control configuration
  kl_ctrl:

    # Required when using verl.utils.omega_conf_to_dataclass to instantiate dataclass configs
    _target_: verl.trainer.config.KLControlConfig

    # KL control type: "fixed" or "adaptive"
    type: fixed

    # Initial coefficient for KL penalty
    kl_coef: 0.001

    # Horizon value for adaptive controller (if enabled)
    horizon: 10000

    # Target KL divergence (used for adaptive controller)
    target_kl: 0.1

  # Whether to enable preference feedback PPO
  use_pf_ppo: False

  # Preference feedback PPO settings
  pf_ppo:

    # Method for reweighting samples: "pow", "max_min", or "max_random"
    reweight_method: pow

    # Power used for weight scaling in "pow" method
    weight_pow: 2.0

# config for the trainer
trainer:

  # Whether to balance batch sizes across distributed workers
  balance_batch: True

  # Number of epochs in training
  total_epochs: 30

  # Total training steps (can be set explicitly or derived from epochs)
  total_training_steps: null

  # Project name for experiment tracking (e.g., wandb)
  project_name: verl_examples

  # Experiment name for run identification in tracking tools
  experiment_name: gsm8k

  # Logging backends to use: "console", "wandb", etc.
  logger: ["console", "wandb"]

  # Number of generations to log during validation
  log_val_generations: 0

  # Directory for logging rollout data; no dump if null
  rollout_data_dir: null

  # Directory for logging validation data; no dump if null
  validation_data_dir: null

  # Number of nodes used in the training
  nnodes: 1

  # Number of GPUs per node
  n_gpus_per_node: 8

  # Save frequency (by iteration) for model checkpoints
  save_freq: -1

  # ESI refers to the elastic server instance used during training, similar to the training plan. For example,
  # if you purchase 10 hours of computing power, the ESI will automatically shut down after 10 hours of training.
  # To ensure a checkpoint is saved before ESI shuts down, the system will start saving a checkpoint in advance.
  # The advance time is calculated as: Advance Time = Longest historical step duration + Checkpoint save duration + esi_redundant_time.
  # Here, esi_redundant_time is a user-defined value that further extends the advance time for added safety.
  esi_redundant_time: 0

  # Resume mode: "auto", "disable", or "resume_path"
  # "auto": resume from last checkpoint if available
  # "disable": start from scratch
  # "resume_path": resume from a user-defined path
  resume_mode: auto

  # Path to resume training from (only used when resume_mode is "resume_path")
  resume_from_path: null

  # Whether to run validation before training begins
  val_before_train: True

  # Whether to run validation only
  val_only: False

  # Validation frequency (in training iterations)
  test_freq: -1

  # Number of iterations to warm up the critic before updating policy
  critic_warmup: 0

  # Default path to distributed filesystem for saving checkpoints
  default_hdfs_dir: null

  # Whether to delete local checkpoints after loading
  del_local_ckpt_after_load: False

  # Default local directory for saving checkpoints
  default_local_dir: checkpoints/${trainer.project_name}/${trainer.experiment_name}

  # Maximum number of actor checkpoints to keep
  max_actor_ckpt_to_keep: null

  # Maximum number of critic checkpoints to keep
  max_critic_ckpt_to_keep: null

  # Timeout (in seconds) for Ray worker to wait for registration
  ray_wait_register_center_timeout: 300

  # Device to run training on (e.g., "cuda", "cpu")
  device: cuda

  # Whether to use V1 trainer
  use_v1: true

  # V1 trainer mode configs
  v1:

    # Trainer mode: "sync", "colocate_async", "separate_async"
    trainer_mode: sync

    # Synchronous PPO trainer
    sync: {}

    # Asynchronous PPO trainer with colocated trainer and rollout
    colocate_async:

      # Number of warmup batches to add before training loop starts
      num_warmup_batches: 1

    # Asynchronous PPO trainer with separate trainer and rollout
    separate_async:

      # Number of warmup batches to add before training loop starts
      num_warmup_batches: 1

      # Frequency of parameter synchronization between trainer and rollout
      parameter_sync_step: 4

    # Replay buffer sampling strategy
    sampler:

      # Maximum number of model versions that trajectory can span
      max_off_policy_threshold: 8

      # How to handle trajectory that exceeds the maximum number of model versions
      # drop: drop the trajectory
      # wait: dropless, wait all trajectories that reach threshold to finish
      max_off_policy_strategy: drop

      # Whether sync trainers replace failed groups that have no trajectories
      sync_refill_failed_groups: False

      # Custom sampler config
      custom_sampler:

        # Path to the custom sampler class
        path: null

        # Name of the custom sampler class
        name: null

      # Additional kwargs for the custom sampler
      sampler_kwargs: {}

# profiler configs
global_profiler:

  # Required when using verl.utils.omega_conf_to_dataclass to instantiate dataclass configs
  _target_: verl.utils.profiler.ProfilerConfig

  # Profiling tool: choose between nsys, npu, torch, torch_memory, precision_debugger
  tool: null

  # profile steps
  steps: null

  # Whether to combine continuous steps into one database.
  ## If True, worker.profiler.discrete must be False, [1,2] in one, [5] in another.
  ## If False, [1] in one, [2] in another, [5] in another.
  profile_continuous_steps: False

  # Path to save profiling contents
  save_path: "outputs/profile"

  # Specific tool configs, can use +profiler.tool_config.[tool].xxx to config
  global_tool_config:

    # nsys config
    nsys:

      # Required when using verl.utils.omega_conf_to_dataclass to instantiate dataclass configs
      _target_: verl.utils.profiler.config.NsightToolConfig

      # True for each task has its own database, False for all tasks in one training step share one database.
      discrete: False

      # controller Nvidia Nsight Systems Options. Must set when profile_steps is not None.
      ## reference https://docs.nvidia.com/nsight-systems/UserGuide/index.html
      ## reference https://docs.ray.io/en/latest/ray-observability/user-guides/profiling.html
      controller_nsight_options:

        # Select the API(s) to be traced.
        trace: "cuda,nvtx,cublas,ucx"

        # Track the GPU memory usage by CUDA kernels. Must be string type "true" or "false".
        cuda-memory-usage: "true"

        # CUDA graphs will be traced as a whole
        cuda-graph-trace: "graph"

      # worker Nvidia Nsight Systems Options. Must set when profile_steps is not None.
      worker_nsight_options:

        # Select the API(s) to be traced.
        trace: "cuda,nvtx,cublas,ucx"

        # Track the GPU memory usage by CUDA kernels. Must be string type "true" or "false".
        cuda-memory-usage: "true"

        # CUDA graphs will be traced as a whole
        cuda-graph-trace: "graph"

        # Profiling only in a range of torch.cuda.profiler.start and stop. Do not change this config.
        capture-range: "cudaProfilerApi"

        # Specify the desired behavior when a capture range ends.
        # In verl we need the torch.cuda.profiler.start/stop pair to repeats n times.
        # valid values are "repeat-shutdown:n" or null.
        # For normal whole step profiling, n = len(profile_steps);
        # but for discrete profiling, n = len(profile_steps) * Number(subtasks).
        # Or you can just leave it null and the program will use n = len(profile_steps) * 6;
        capture-range-end: null

        # Send signal to the target application's process group. We let the program to exit by itself.
        kill: none

    # enable memory visualization for debugging memory usage
    torch_memory:

      #  Maximum number of allocation entries to record
      trace_alloc_max_entries: 100_000

      # The depth of the call stack to capture for each allocation
      stack_depth: 32

      # 'alloc': records only allocation events || 'state': records memory state changes || 'all': records both.
      context: "all"

      # 'python': records Python stacks || 'cpp': records C++ stacks (available in some versions) || 'all': records both.
      stacks: "all"

      # devices, record_context etc.
      kw_args: {}

    # msprobe precision debugger
    precision_debugger:

      # Required when using verl.utils.omega_conf_to_dataclass to instantiate dataclass configs
      _target_: verl.utils.profiler.config.PrecisionDebuggerToolConfig

      # Path to msprobe config json
      config_path: null

      # Deprecated and ignored. Use global_profiler.steps.
      steps: null

      # Profile stages
      # Supported stages: actor_update, actor_compute_log_prob, ref_compute_log_prob,
      # compute_values, critic_update, compute_rm_score
      stages: null

      # Whether to fail on unknown stage or missing msprobe
      strict: False

# configs for SkipManager
skip:

  # Required when using verl.utils.omega_conf_to_dataclass to instantiate dataclass configs
  _target_: verl.utils.skip.SkipManagerConfig

  # configs for RolloutSkip 
  rollout:

    # Whether to enable RolloutSkip
    enable: False

    # Directory to save rollout data
    dump_dir: "~/.verl/rollout_dump"

    # Steps to skip rollout
    steps: []

  # Action to take when rollout is skipped, refer to verl.utils.skip.base_skip.SkipAction
    action: cache

  # configs for RolloutTqSkip (V1 TransferQueue-based trainer)
  rollout_tq:

    # Whether to enable RolloutTqSkip
    enable: False

    # Directory to save rollout data
    dump_dir: "~/.verl/rollout_dump"

    # Steps to skip rollout
    steps: []

    # Action to take when rollout is skipped (cache | repeat)
    action: cache

  # configs for AsyncRolloutSkip (fully async policy)
  async_rollout:

    # Whether to enable AsyncRolloutSkip
    enable: False

    # Directory to save rollout data
    dump_dir: "~/.verl/rollout_dump"

    # Steps to skip rollout (rollouter global_steps from sample_id)
    steps: []

    # Action to take when rollout is skipped, refer to verl.utils.skip.base_skip.SkipAction
    action: cache

# configs related to ray
ray_kwargs:

  # configs related to ray initialization
  ray_init:

    # Number of CPUs for Ray. Use a fixed number instead of null when using SLURM.
    num_cpus: null

  # Path to save Ray timeline JSON for performance profiling
  timeline_json_file: null

34	    global _pool

37	            if _pool is None:

42	def _verify_in_subprocess(ground_truth_boxed: str, model_output: str) -> float:
43	    """Run math_verify in a subprocess where signal.alarm() works."""
44	    from math_verify.grader import verify
45	    from math_verify.parser import ExprExtractionConfig, LatexExtractionConfig, parse
46	
47	    gold_targets = (LatexExtractionConfig(),)
48	    pred_targets = (ExprExtractionConfig(), LatexExtractionConfig())
49	
50	    extracted_gold = parse(ground_truth_boxed, gold_targets)
51	    extracted_pred = parse(model_output, pred_targets)
52	    if extracted_gold and extracted_pred:
53	        return max(1.0 if any(verify(g, p) for g in extracted_gold) else 0.0 for p in extracted_pred)
54	    return 0.0

import multiprocessing
import threading
from concurrent.futures import ProcessPoolExecutor
from concurrent.futures import TimeoutError as FuturesTimeoutError

try:
    from math_verify.errors import TimeoutException
except ImportError:

    class TimeoutException(Exception):
        pass

    print("To use Math-Verify, please install it first by running `pip install math-verify`.")

_pool = None
_pool_lock = threading.Lock()


def _get_pool():
    global _pool
    if _pool is None:
        with _pool_lock:
            if _pool is None:
                _pool = ProcessPoolExecutor(max_workers=4, mp_context=multiprocessing.get_context("spawn"))
    return _pool


def _verify_in_subprocess(ground_truth_boxed: str, model_output: str) -> float:
    """Run math_verify in a subprocess where signal.alarm() works."""
    from math_verify.grader import verify
    from math_verify.parser import ExprExtractionConfig, LatexExtractionConfig, parse

    gold_targets = (LatexExtractionConfig(),)
    pred_targets = (ExprExtractionConfig(), LatexExtractionConfig())

    extracted_gold = parse(ground_truth_boxed, gold_targets)
    extracted_pred = parse(model_output, pred_targets)
    if extracted_gold and extracted_pred:
        return max(1.0 if any(verify(g, p) for g in extracted_gold) else 0.0 for p in extracted_pred)
    return 0.0


def compute_score(model_output: str, ground_truth: str, timeout_score: float = 0, timeout: float = 30.0) -> float:
    ret_score = 0.0
    ground_truth_boxed = "\\boxed{" + ground_truth + "}"
    try:
        future = _get_pool().submit(_verify_in_subprocess, ground_truth_boxed, model_output)
        ret_score = future.result(timeout=timeout)
    except (FuturesTimeoutError, TimeoutException):
        ret_score = timeout_score
    except Exception as e:
        print(f"Error in math_verify compute_score: {e}")
    return ret_score

# from . import gsm8k, math, prime_math, prime_code

from verl.utils.import_utils import deprecated


def default_compute_score(
    data_source,
    solution_str,
    ground_truth,
    extra_info=None,
    sandbox_fusion_url=None,
    concurrent_semaphore=None,
    memory_limit_mb=None,
    **kwargs,
):
    """Compute the score for a given solution based on the data source.

    Args:
        data_source (str): The source dataset identifier which determines the scoring method.
        solution_str (str): The solution string to be evaluated.
        ground_truth (str): The ground truth answer for comparison.
        extra_info (dict, optional): Additional information that might be needed for scoring. Defaults to None.

    Returns:
        float: The computed score as a floating point number. If the result is a dictionary,
               it returns the dictionary instead.

    Raises:
        NotImplementedError: If the reward function is not implemented for the given data source.
    """
    if data_source == "openai/gsm8k":
        from . import gsm8k

        res = gsm8k.compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth)
    elif data_source in ["lighteval/MATH", "DigitalLearningGmbH/MATH-lighteval", "HuggingFaceH4/MATH-500"]:
        from . import math_reward

        res = math_reward.compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth)
        # [Optional] Math-Verify Integration
        # For enhanced accuracy, consider utilizing Math-Verify (https://github.com/huggingface/Math-Verify).
        # Note: Math-Verify needs to be manually installed via pip: `pip install math-verify`.
        # To use it, override the `compute_score` function with the following implementation:

        # from . import math_verify
        # res = math_verify.compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth)
    elif data_source in ["math_dapo", "math", "math_dapo_reasoning"] or data_source.startswith("aime"):
        from . import math_dapo

        res = math_dapo.compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth)
    elif data_source in [
        "numina_aops_forum",
        "numina_synthetic_math",
        "numina_amc_aime",
        "numina_synthetic_amc",
        "numina_cn_k12",
        "numina_olympiads",
    ]:
        from . import prime_math

        res = prime_math.compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth)
    elif data_source in ["codecontests", "apps", "codeforces", "taco"]:
        # Use the passed sandbox_fusion_url if available
        if sandbox_fusion_url:
            from . import sandbox_fusion

            # Pass the URL directly, ground_truth likely contains test cases here
            res = sandbox_fusion.compute_score(
                sandbox_fusion_url, concurrent_semaphore, memory_limit_mb, solution_str, ground_truth, continuous=True
            )
        else:
            # If no sandbox URL is provided, fall back to prime_code or raise error
            from . import prime_code

            # Assuming prime_code doesn't need the URL
            res = prime_code.compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth, continuous=True)
    elif data_source in ["hiyouga/geometry3k"]:
        from . import geo3k

        res = geo3k.compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth)
    elif data_source in [
        "searchR1_nq",
        "searchR1_triviaqa",
        "searchR1_popqa",
        "searchR1_hotpotqa",
        "searchR1_2wikimultihopqa",
        "searchR1_musique",
        "searchR1_bamboogle",
    ]:
        from . import search_r1_like_qa_em

        res = search_r1_like_qa_em.compute_score(solution_str, ground_truth)

    else:
        raise NotImplementedError(f"Reward function is not implemented for {data_source=}")

    if isinstance(res, dict):
        return res
    elif isinstance(res, int | float | bool):
        return float(res)
    else:
        return float(res[0])


@deprecated("verl.utils.reward_score.default_compute_score")
def _default_compute_score(
    data_source,
    solution_str,
    ground_truth,
    extra_info=None,
    sandbox_fusion_url=None,
    concurrent_semaphore=None,
    memory_limit_mb=None,
):
    """
    Legacy function API to be deprecated. Please use `default_compute_score` instead.
    """
    return default_compute_score(
        data_source, solution_str, ground_truth, extra_info, sandbox_fusion_url, concurrent_semaphore, memory_limit_mb
    )


def get_default_compute_score(reward_name: str | None):
    """Get the default compute_score function based on the reward manager type."""
    return default_compute_score


__all__ = ["default_compute_score"]

from __future__ import annotations

import inspect
import multiprocessing
from functools import partial
from typing import TYPE_CHECKING, Any, Optional, cast

from verl import DataProto
from verl.utils.reward_score import get_default_compute_score

if TYPE_CHECKING:
    from omegaconf import DictConfig

    from verl.experimental.reward_loop.reward_manager.base import RawRewardFn, RewardManagerBase
    from verl.trainer.config.config import ModuleConfig
    from verl.workers.config.reward import RewardManagerConfig


def _call_with_kwargs(raw_fn, extra_kwargs, *args, **kwargs):
    """Calls `raw_fn` by merging `extra_kwargs` into call-time `kwargs`, with `extra_kwargs` taking precedence.

    This function is used to merge additional keyword arguments with the original function's arguments.
    """
    merged_kwargs = {**kwargs, **extra_kwargs}
    return raw_fn(*args, **merged_kwargs)


async def _call_with_kwargs_async(raw_fn, extra_kwargs, *args, **kwargs):
    """Calls `raw_fn` by merging `extra_kwargs` into call-time `kwargs`, with `extra_kwargs` taking precedence.

    This function is used to merge additional keyword arguments with the original function's arguments.
    """
    merged_kwargs = {**kwargs, **extra_kwargs}
    return await raw_fn(*args, **merged_kwargs)


def get_custom_reward_fn(config: DictConfig) -> Optional[RawRewardFn]:
    """Load and return a custom reward function from external file.

    Dynamically imports a reward function from a specified file path and wraps
    it with additional keyword arguments from the configuration.

    Args:
        config (dict): Configuration dictionary containing custom_reward_function
                      settings with 'path', 'name', and 'reward_kwargs' fields.

    Returns:
        callable or None: Wrapped reward function with merged kwargs, or None
                         if no custom reward function is configured.

    Raises:
        FileNotFoundError: If the specified reward function file doesn't exist.
        RuntimeError: If there's an error loading the module from file.
        AttributeError: If the specified function name isn't found in the module.
    """

    reward_fn_config = config.reward.get("custom_reward_function") or {}
    module_path = reward_fn_config.get("path")
    if not module_path:
        return None

    fn_name = reward_fn_config.get("name")
    assert fn_name is not None

    from verl.utils.import_utils import load_extern_object

    raw_fn = load_extern_object(module_path=module_path, object_name=fn_name)

    reward_kwargs = dict(reward_fn_config.get("reward_kwargs", {}))
    if not inspect.iscoroutinefunction(raw_fn):
        return partial(_call_with_kwargs, raw_fn, reward_kwargs)
    else:
        return partial(_call_with_kwargs_async, raw_fn, reward_kwargs)


def resolve_reward_manager_cls(config: DictConfig) -> type[RewardManagerBase]:
    """Resolve the reward manager class from ``config`` without instantiating it."""
    reward_manager_cfg: RewardManagerConfig = config.reward.reward_manager
    if reward_manager_cfg.source == "register":
        from verl.experimental.reward_loop.reward_manager import get_reward_manager_cls

        return get_reward_manager_cls(reward_manager_cfg.name)
    elif reward_manager_cfg.source == "importlib":
        from verl.utils.import_utils import load_extern_object

        module_cfg: ModuleConfig | None = reward_manager_cfg.module
        assert module_cfg is not None and module_cfg.path is not None, (
            f"Module path is required when {reward_manager_cfg.source=}, but got {module_cfg=}"
        )
        return cast(
            "type[RewardManagerBase]",
            load_extern_object(module_path=module_cfg.path, object_name=reward_manager_cfg.name),
        )
    else:
        raise ValueError(f"Unknown reward manager source: {reward_manager_cfg.source}")


def load_reward_manager(config: DictConfig, tokenizer: Any, **reward_kwargs: Any) -> RewardManagerBase:
    """
    Load and initialize a reward manager based on the configuration.

    Args:
        config: PPO trainer configuration object containing reward_model fields.
        tokenizer: Tokenizer object used for processing text.
        **reward_kwargs: Additional keyword arguments for the reward manager.

    Returns:
        An instance of the specified reward manager class.
    """

    # Try to get a custom reward function based on the configuration
    # user defined reward manager can be registered in custom_reward_fn
    compute_score = get_custom_reward_fn(config)
    final_compute_score = compute_score

    reward_manager_cfg: RewardManagerConfig = config.reward.reward_manager
    reward_manager_cls = resolve_reward_manager_cls(config)

    default_compute_score_ = get_default_compute_score(reward_manager_cfg.name)

    if compute_score is None:
        sandbox_config = config.reward.get("sandbox_fusion")
        sandbox_url = sandbox_config.get("url") if sandbox_config else None
        memory_limit_mb = sandbox_config.get("memory_limit_mb", 1024) if sandbox_config else 1024
        if sandbox_url:
            sandbox_manager = multiprocessing.Manager()
            # Create a semaphore to control concurrent access to the sandbox
            _concurrent_semaphore = sandbox_manager.Semaphore(sandbox_config.get("max_concurrent", 64))
            final_compute_score = partial(
                default_compute_score_,
                sandbox_fusion_url=sandbox_url,
                concurrent_semaphore=_concurrent_semaphore,
                memory_limit_mb=memory_limit_mb,
            )
        else:
            final_compute_score = default_compute_score_

    # Instantiate and return the reward manager with the specified parameters
    return reward_manager_cls(
        config=config,
        tokenizer=tokenizer,
        compute_score=final_compute_score,
        **reward_kwargs,
    )


def extract_reward(batch: DataProto):
    """
    Extract reward tensor and extra info from batch data.
    """
    reward_tensor = batch.batch["rm_scores"]
    reward_extra_keys = batch.meta_info.get("reward_extra_keys", [])
    reward_extra_infos_dict = {key: batch.non_tensor_batch[key] for key in reward_extra_keys}
    return reward_tensor, reward_extra_infos_dict

6	# is Math-Verify through verl's built-in scorer (rewards/math_verify_reward.py, wired in with
7	# reward.custom_reward_function); verl uses the same function for the held-out metric

78	def apply_kl_penalty(data: DataProto, kl_ctrl: core_algos.AdaptiveKLController, kl_penalty="kl"):
79	    """Apply KL penalty to the token-level rewards.
80	
81	    This function computes the KL divergence between the reference policy and current policy,
82	    then applies a penalty to the token-level rewards based on this divergence.
83	
84	    Args:
85	        data (DataProto): The data containing batched model outputs and inputs.
86	        kl_ctrl (core_algos.AdaptiveKLController): Controller for adaptive KL penalty.
87	        kl_penalty (str, optional): Type of KL penalty to apply. Defaults to "kl".
88	
89	    Returns:
90	        tuple: A tuple containing:
91	            - The updated data with token-level rewards adjusted by KL penalty
92	            - A dictionary of metrics related to the KL penalty
93	    """
94	    response_mask = data.batch["response_mask"]
95	    token_level_scores = data.batch["token_level_scores"]
96	    batch_size = data.batch.batch_size[0]
97	
98	    # compute kl between ref_policy and current policy
99	    # When apply_kl_penalty, algorithm.use_kl_in_reward=True, so the reference model has been enabled.
100	    kld = core_algos.kl_penalty(
101	        data.batch["old_log_probs"], data.batch["ref_log_prob"], kl_penalty=kl_penalty
102	    )  # (batch_size, response_length)
103	    kld = kld * response_mask
104	    beta = kl_ctrl.value
105	
106	    token_level_rewards = token_level_scores - beta * kld
107	
108	    current_kl = masked_mean(kld, mask=response_mask, axis=-1)  # average over sequence
109	    current_kl = torch.mean(current_kl, dim=0).item()
110	
111	    # according to https://github.com/huggingface/trl/blob/951ca1841f29114b969b57b26c7d3e80a39f75a0/trl/trainer/ppo_trainer.py#L837
112	    kl_ctrl.update(current_kl=current_kl, n_steps=batch_size)
113	    data.batch["token_level_rewards"] = token_level_rewards
114	
115	    metrics = {"actor/reward_kl_penalty": current_kl, "actor/reward_kl_penalty_coeff": beta}
116	
117	    return data, metrics

120	def compute_response_mask(data: DataProto):
121	    """Compute the attention mask for the response part of the sequence.
122	
123	    This function extracts the portion of the attention mask that corresponds to the model's response,
124	    which is used for masking computations that should only apply to response tokens.
125	
126	    Args:
127	        data (DataProto): The data containing batched model outputs and inputs.
128	
129	    Returns:
130	        torch.Tensor: The attention mask for the response tokens.
131	    """
132	    responses = data.batch["responses"]
133	    response_length = responses.size(1)
134	    attention_mask = data.batch["attention_mask"]
135	    return attention_mask[:, -response_length:]

138	def compute_spec_decode_metrics(
139	    spec_drafts,
140	    spec_accepts,
141	    spec_verifies,
142	    non_padding_mask=None,
143	) -> dict:
144	    """Aggregate per-request speculative decoding stats.
145	
146	    Ratios are computed per request and then averaged, so long and short
147	    responses have equal metric weight.
148	
149	    The three inputs come from the rollout engine (vLLM request spec-decode
150	    stats or sglang ``meta_info["spec_*"]`` keys). Either all three are ``None``
151	    (caller didn't fetch them, e.g. spec rollout disabled) and the function
152	    is a no-op, or all three are populated; mixed state is a programmer error.
153	
154	    ``non_padding_mask`` is a numpy bool array used by sync PPO to drop padded
155	    placeholder samples; pass ``None`` for async PPO.
156	    """
157	    if spec_drafts is None and spec_accepts is None and spec_verifies is None:
158	        return {}
159	    assert spec_drafts is not None and spec_accepts is not None and spec_verifies is not None, (
160	        "spec_decode metrics require all three of spec_num_draft_tokens / "
161	        "spec_num_accepted_tokens / spec_num_verify_steps; got partial inputs"
162	    )
163	
164	    drafts = spec_drafts.tolist() if hasattr(spec_drafts, "tolist") else list(spec_drafts)
165	    accepts = spec_accepts.tolist() if hasattr(spec_accepts, "tolist") else list(spec_accepts)
166	    verifies = spec_verifies.tolist() if hasattr(spec_verifies, "tolist") else list(spec_verifies)
167	
168	    if non_padding_mask is not None:
169	        drafts = [d for d, keep in zip(drafts, non_padding_mask, strict=True) if keep]
170	        accepts = [a for a, keep in zip(accepts, non_padding_mask, strict=True) if keep]
171	        verifies = [v for v, keep in zip(verifies, non_padding_mask, strict=True) if keep]
172	
173	    if len(drafts) == 0:
174	        return {}
175	
176	    # Treat zero-denominator samples as 0.0 and keep them in the mean.
177	    per_sample_accept_rate = [(a / d) if d > 0 else 0.0 for a, d in zip(accepts, drafts, strict=True)]
178	    per_sample_accept_length = [(1.0 + a / v) if v > 0 else 0.0 for a, v in zip(accepts, verifies, strict=True)]
179	
180	    n = len(drafts)
181	    return {
182	        "rollout/spec_accept_rate": float(sum(per_sample_accept_rate) / n),
183	        "rollout/spec_accept_length": float(sum(per_sample_accept_length) / n),
184	    }

187	def compute_advantage(
188	    data: DataProto,
189	    adv_estimator: AdvantageEstimator,
190	    gamma: float = 1.0,
191	    lam: float = 1.0,
192	    num_repeat: int = 1,
193	    norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo: bool = True,
194	    config: Optional[AlgoConfig] = None,
195	) -> DataProto:
196	    """Compute advantage estimates for policy optimization.
197	
198	    This function computes advantage estimates using various estimators like GAE, GRPO, REINFORCE++, etc.
199	    The advantage estimates are used to guide policy optimization in RL algorithms.
200	
201	    Args:
202	        data (DataProto): The data containing batched model outputs and inputs.
203	        adv_estimator (AdvantageEstimator): The advantage estimator to use (e.g., GAE, GRPO, REINFORCE++).
204	        gamma (float, optional): Discount factor for future rewards. Defaults to 1.0.
205	        lam (float, optional): Lambda parameter for GAE. Defaults to 1.0.
206	        num_repeat (int, optional): Number of times to repeat the computation. Defaults to 1.
207	        norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo (bool, optional): Whether to normalize advantages by standard deviation in
208	            GRPO. Defaults to True.
209	        config (dict, optional): Configuration dictionary for algorithm settings. Defaults to None.
210	
211	    Returns:
212	        DataProto: The updated data with computed advantages and returns.
213	    """
214	    # Back-compatible with trainers that do not compute response mask in fit
215	    if "response_mask" not in data.batch.keys():
216	        data.batch["response_mask"] = compute_response_mask(data)
217	    # prepare response group
218	    if adv_estimator == AdvantageEstimator.GAE:
219	        # Compute advantages and returns using Generalized Advantage Estimation (GAE)
220	        advantages, returns = core_algos.compute_gae_advantage_return(
221	            token_level_rewards=data.batch["token_level_rewards"],
222	            values=data.batch["values"],
223	            response_mask=data.batch["response_mask"],
224	            gamma=gamma,
225	            lam=lam,
226	        )
227	        data.batch["advantages"] = advantages
228	        data.batch["returns"] = returns
229	        if config.get("use_pf_ppo", False):
230	            data = core_algos.compute_pf_ppo_reweight_data(
231	                data,
232	                config.pf_ppo.get("reweight_method"),
233	                config.pf_ppo.get("weight_pow"),
234	            )
235	    elif adv_estimator == AdvantageEstimator.GRPO:
236	        # Initialize the mask for GRPO calculation
237	        grpo_calculation_mask = data.batch["response_mask"]
238	
239	        # Call compute_grpo_outcome_advantage with parameters matching its definition
240	        advantages, returns = core_algos.compute_grpo_outcome_advantage(
241	            token_level_rewards=data.batch["token_level_rewards"],
242	            response_mask=grpo_calculation_mask,
243	            index=data.non_tensor_batch["uid"],
244	            norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo=norm_adv_by_std_in_grpo,
245	        )
246	        data.batch["advantages"] = advantages
247	        data.batch["returns"] = returns
248	    else:
249	        # handle all other adv estimator type other than GAE and GRPO
250	        adv_estimator_fn = core_algos.get_adv_estimator_fn(adv_estimator)
251	        adv_kwargs = {
252	            "token_level_rewards": data.batch["token_level_rewards"],
253	            "response_mask": data.batch["response_mask"],
254	            "config": config,
255	        }
256	        if "uid" in data.non_tensor_batch:  # optional
257	            adv_kwargs["index"] = data.non_tensor_batch["uid"]
258	        if "reward_baselines" in data.batch:  # optional
259	            adv_kwargs["reward_baselines"] = data.batch["reward_baselines"]
260	        # GDPO: pass raw data for per-dimension reward extraction
261	        if adv_estimator in (AdvantageEstimator.GDPO, "gdpo"):
262	            adv_kwargs["non_tensor_batch"] = data.non_tensor_batch
263	            adv_kwargs["batch"] = data.batch
264	        # Add sum_pi_squared for Optimal Token Baseline
265	        if adv_estimator in (AdvantageEstimator.OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE, AdvantageEstimator.TIR_OPTIMAL_TOKEN_BASELINE):
266	            # Check if sum_pi_squared is available
267	            assert "sum_pi_squared" in data.batch, (
268	                "Step-dependent optimal baseline requires sum_pi_squared from actor. "
269	                "Please set actor.calculate_sum_pi_squared=True in config."
270	            )
271	            adv_kwargs["sum_pi_squared"] = data.batch["sum_pi_squared"]
272	            # old_log_probs needed for path-variance proxy: w_t = 1 - 2*exp(old_log_probs) + sum_pi_squared
273	            adv_kwargs["old_log_probs"] = data.batch["old_log_probs"]
274	            # Get pre-computed rollout IS weights if available
275	            rollout_is_weights = data.batch.get("rollout_is_weights", None)
276	            adv_kwargs["rollout_is_weights"] = rollout_is_weights
277	
278	        # calculate advantage estimator
279	        advantages, returns = adv_estimator_fn(**adv_kwargs)
280	        data.batch["advantages"] = advantages
281	        data.batch["returns"] = returns
282	    return data

180	    def _postprocess_output(self, output, *, global_token_num, delta_time, forward_only, images_seqlens):
181	        """
182	
183	        Args:
184	            output: a dictionary containing loss, model_outputs and metrics
185	
186	        Returns:
187	
188	        """
189	
190	        metrics: dict = output.pop("metrics")
191	        # perform all gather in dp group to ensure that it's correct.
192	        # Here each metric in metrics can be a list (micro-batch metrics) or a singleton
193	        # we should always sum the loss of each micro-batch as we scale by global_bsz/global_token
194	        loss = torch.sum(torch.tensor(output.pop("loss"), device=self.device_name))
195	        dp_group = self.engine.get_data_parallel_group()
196	        if dp_group is not None:
197	            torch.distributed.all_reduce(loss, op=torch.distributed.ReduceOp.AVG, group=dp_group)
198	        loss = loss.item()
199	
200	        # For grad_norm, we do not perform all reduce because it is already been done when clipping grad
201	        grad_norm = metrics.pop("grad_norm", None)
202	        if isinstance(grad_norm, torch.Tensor):
203	            grad_norm = grad_norm.detach().item()
204	        lr = metrics.pop("lr", None)
205	
206	        # For other metrics, we perform all gather in dp group (only if DP > 1)
207	        if dp_group is not None:
208	            final_metrics = allgather_dict_into_dict(data=metrics, group=dp_group)
209	        else:
210	            final_metrics = metrics
211	        final_metrics["loss"] = loss
212	        if grad_norm is not None:
213	            final_metrics["grad_norm"] = grad_norm
214	        if lr is not None:
215	            final_metrics["lr"] = lr
216	
217	        # log memory
218	        final_metrics["perf/max_memory_allocated_gb"] = get_torch_device().max_memory_allocated() / (1024**3)
219	        final_metrics["perf/max_memory_reserved_gb"] = get_torch_device().max_memory_reserved() / (1024**3)
220	        final_metrics["perf/cpu_memory_used_gb"] = psutil.virtual_memory().used / (1024**3)
221	
222	        # TODO: confirm the mtp loss IS same across dp
223	        for k, v in final_metrics.items():
224	            if k.startswith("mtp_losses"):
225	                flatten_v = [sublist[0] for sublist in v]  # sublist should be single element
226	                final_metrics[k] = sum(flatten_v) / len(flatten_v)
227	        # compute mfu
228	        if global_token_num is not None and self.flops_counter is not None:
229	            estimated_flops, promised_flops = self.flops_counter.estimate_flops(
230	                global_token_num, delta_time, images_seqlens=images_seqlens
231	            )
232	            final_metrics["mfu"] = estimated_flops / promised_flops / torch.distributed.get_world_size()
233	            if forward_only:
234	                final_metrics["mfu"] /= 3.0
235	        # model outputs
236	        model_output = output.pop("model_output", {})
237	        # We only return final_metrics
238	        final_output = tu.get_tensordict(tensor_dict=model_output, non_tensor_dict={"metrics": final_metrics})
239	        return final_output

242	    def train_mini_batch(self, data: TensorDict) -> TensorDict:
243	        """Split a batch into N mini-batches run for multiple epochs
244	
245	        Args:
246	            data:
247	
248	        Returns:
249	
250	        """
251	        maybe_fix_3d_position_ids(data)
252	        batch_size_per_dp = data.shape[0]
253	        disable_auto_offload = tu.pop(data, key="disable_auto_offload", default=False)
254	        mini_batch_size = tu.pop(data, key="mini_batch_size", default=None)
255	        num_mini_batch = tu.pop(data, key="num_mini_batch", default=None)
256	        epochs = tu.pop(data, key="epochs", default=1)
257	        seed = tu.pop(data, key="seed", default=42)
258	        dataloader_kwargs = tu.pop(data, key="dataloader_kwargs", default={})
259	
260	        assert mini_batch_size is not None or num_mini_batch is not None
261	
262	        if mini_batch_size is None:
263	            assert batch_size_per_dp % num_mini_batch == 0, f"Got {batch_size_per_dp=} and {num_mini_batch=}"
264	            mini_batch_size_per_gpu = batch_size_per_dp // num_mini_batch
265	        else:
266	            assert mini_batch_size % self.engine.get_data_parallel_size() == 0, (
267	                f"Got {mini_batch_size=} and {self.engine.get_data_parallel_size()=}"
268	            )
269	            mini_batch_size_per_gpu = mini_batch_size // self.engine.get_data_parallel_size()
270	
271	        # make iterator
272	        dataloader = tu.make_iterator(
273	            data,
274	            mini_batch_size=mini_batch_size_per_gpu,
275	            epochs=epochs,
276	            seed=seed + self.engine.get_data_parallel_rank(),
277	            dataloader_kwargs=dataloader_kwargs,
278	        )
279	
280	        with (
281	            self.engine.train_mode(disable_auto_offload=disable_auto_offload),
282	            Timer(name="train_batch", logger=None),
283	        ):
284	            # update
285	            output_lst = []
286	            total_num_iterations = data.shape[0] // mini_batch_size_per_gpu * epochs
287	
288	            for batch_idx, mini_batch_td in enumerate(dataloader):
289	                maybe_fix_3d_position_ids(mini_batch_td)
290	                # add global token num
291	                if "input_ids" in mini_batch_td:
292	                    global_token_num = mini_batch_td["input_ids"].offsets().diff().tolist()  # (total_nnz,)
293	                    # allgather from dp rank
294	                    global_token_num_output = [None] * torch.distributed.get_world_size(
295	                        self.engine.get_data_parallel_group()
296	                    )
297	                    torch.distributed.all_gather_object(
298	                        global_token_num_output, global_token_num, self.engine.get_data_parallel_group()
299	                    )
300	                    global_token_num = [x for xs in global_token_num_output for x in xs]
301	                else:
302	                    global_token_num = None
303	
304	                tu.assign_non_tensor(
305	                    mini_batch_td,
306	                    global_token_num=NonTensorData(global_token_num),
307	                    update_lr_scheduler=batch_idx == total_num_iterations - 1,
308	                    disable_auto_offload=True,
309	                )
310	                actor_output = self.train_batch(mini_batch_td)
311	                output_lst.append(actor_output)
312	                # Advance the profiler schedule once per mini-batch. No-op unless a
313	                # torch profiler schedule (wait/warmup/active/repeat) is active.
314	                self.profiler.step()
315	
316	            if self.engine.is_mp_src_rank_with_outputs():
317	                actor_output = [tu.get(output, "metrics") for output in output_lst]
318	                metrics = {}
319	                for output in actor_output:
320	                    for key, val in output.items():
321	                        # flattn dp and micro batch
322	                        if isinstance(val, list):
323	                            output[key] = (
324	                                Metric.aggregate_dp(val)
325	                                if isinstance(val[0], Metric)
326	                                else list(chain.from_iterable(val))
327	                            )
328	                    append_to_dict(metrics, output)
329	
330	                output = tu.get_tensordict(tensor_dict={}, non_tensor_dict={"metrics": metrics}).cpu()
331	            else:
332	                output = None
333	        return output

719	    @register(dispatch_mode=Dispatch.ONE_TO_ALL, blocking=False)
720	    async def update_weights(self, global_steps: int = None, mode: str = "auto"):
721	        """Update weights from trainer to rollout.
722	
723	        1. For sync training with colocated trainer and rollout, update rollout directly from model engine.
724	           - before update_weights: rollout should be in sleep mode.
725	           - after update_weights: rollout should be in wake_up mode.
726	        2. For async training with disaggregated trainer and rollout, send_weights only by checkpoint engine.
727	
728	        LoRA handling: when model.lora.merge=True (peft_merge), LoRA is merged into
729	        base weights before sync. The engine returns full HF-keyed params with
730	        peft_config=None, so the rollout receives a standard weight update.
731	
732	        Args:
733	            global_steps: Current global training step count, passed to rollout for logging/tracking.
734	            mode: Weight update strategy. Supported values:
735	                - ``"auto"``: Automatically resolve to the backend configured in
736	                  ``config.rollout.checkpoint_engine.backend`` (default).
737	                - ``"naive"``: Direct in-process weight sync between colocated trainer
738	                  and rollout. Used for synchronous training where both share the same
739	                  process. Rollout must be in sleep mode before this call.
740	                - Any other value: Delegates to
741	                  :meth:`checkpoint_engine.send_weights` for asynchronous weight
742	                  transfer via checkpoint engine, suitable for disaggregated
743	                  trainer/rollout deployments.
744	        """
745	
746	        # Resolve mode: "auto" falls back to config, explicit values take precedence
747	        effective_mode = mode if mode != "auto" else self.config.rollout.checkpoint_engine.backend
748	
749	        # 0. send_weights only for async training with disaggregated trainer and rollout
750	        if effective_mode != "naive":
751	            if effective_mode == "delta_sharded":
752	                # the delta engine owns the sync state machine (seed vs steady,
753	                # snapshot prime), so it drives the training engine itself.
754	                metrics = await self.checkpoint_engine.send_weights(self.actor.engine, global_steps=global_steps)
755	                return metrics or {}
756	            per_tensor_param, _ = self.actor.engine.get_per_tensor_param()
757	            metrics = await self.checkpoint_engine.send_weights(per_tensor_param, global_steps=global_steps)
758	            return metrics or {}
759	
760	        set_expandable_segments(False)
761	        aggressive_empty_cache(force_sync=True)
762	        log_gpu_memory_usage("Before resume weights", logger=logger)
763	
764	        # 1. resume rollout memory (weights were released during sleep)
765	        if self.config.rollout.free_cache_engine:
766	            await self.rollout.resume(tags=["weights"])
767	        log_gpu_memory_usage("After resume weights", logger=logger)
768	
769	        # 2. determine if we need a base weight sync (adapter path only)
770	        per_tensor_param, peft_config = self.actor.engine.get_per_tensor_param(
771	            layered_summon=self.layered_summon, base_sync_done=True
772	        )
773	
774	        do_lora_base_sync = False
775	        if not self.peft_merge and peft_config is not None:
776	            self.rollout.sleep_level = 1
777	            do_lora_base_sync = not self.base_sync_done
778	
779	        # 3. sync weights: For SGLang, we need base first (when needed), then adapter/merged
780	        if do_lora_base_sync:
781	            per_tensor_param_base, _base_peft_config = self.actor.engine.get_per_tensor_param(
782	                layered_summon=self.layered_summon, base_sync_done=False
783	            )
784	            await self.rollout.update_weights(
785	                per_tensor_param_base, peft_config=_base_peft_config, base_sync_done=False, global_steps=global_steps
786	            )
787	
788	        await self.rollout.update_weights(
789	            per_tensor_param, peft_config=peft_config, base_sync_done=True, global_steps=global_steps
790	        )
791	
792	        log_gpu_memory_usage("After update_weights", logger=logger)
793	
794	        # 3. offload model to cpu
795	        if self.actor.engine.is_param_offload_enabled:
796	            self.actor.engine.to("cpu", model=True, optimizer=False, grad=False)
797	        aggressive_empty_cache(force_sync=True)
798	
799	        # 4. resume kv_cache
800	        if self.config.rollout.free_cache_engine:
801	            await self.rollout.resume(tags=["kv_cache"])
802	        log_gpu_memory_usage("After resume kv_cache", logger=logger)
803	
804	        self.base_sync_done = True
805	        set_expandable_segments(True)
806

14	"""
15	The vllm_rollout that can be applied in different backend
16	When working with FSDP:
17	- Use DTensor weight loader (recommended) or HF weight loader
18	- Utilize state_dict from the FSDP to synchronize the weights among tp ranks in vLLM
19	When working with Megatron:
20	- Use Megatron weight loader
21	- During training, only the current pp stage holds the parameters
22	- Before inference, broadcast the parameters of the current pp rank
23	  to all other pp ranks (all pp ranks holds all the parameters)
24	- Bind the parameters to the inference engine
25	- Do inference in tp. pp is treated as additional dp
26	- After inference, all the parameters that doesn't belong to this pp rank is freed.
27	"""

49	class ServerAdapter(BaseRollout):
50	    """
51	    vLLM server adapter used in native async mode, serve as a client to request vLLM server
52	    to resume/release/update weights and kv_cache.

54	
55	    def __init__(
56	        self,
57	        config: RolloutConfig,
58	        model_config: HFModelConfig,
59	        device_mesh: DeviceMesh,
60	        replica_rank: int = -1,
61	    ):
62	        super().__init__(config, model_config, device_mesh)
63	        self.server_handle: ray.actor.ActorHandle = None
64	
65	        rank = int(os.environ["RANK"])
66	        local_world_size = int(os.environ["RAY_LOCAL_WORLD_SIZE"])
67	        # PD asymmetric layout inflates per-replica footprint; must match
68	        # llm_server.py:_initialize_llm_servers or trainer-to-replica mapping breaks.
69	        prefill_tp = self.config.tensor_model_parallel_size
70	        disagg = getattr(self.config, "disaggregation", None)
71	        if disagg is not None and getattr(disagg, "enabled", False):
72	            decode_tp = (
73	                disagg.decode_tensor_model_parallel_size
74	                if disagg.decode_tensor_model_parallel_size is not None
75	                else prefill_tp
76	            )
77	            per_replica = prefill_tp * disagg.prefill_replicas + decode_tp * disagg.decode_replicas
78	        else:
79	            decode_tp = prefill_tp

28	def sft_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
29	    pad_mode = tu.get_non_tensor_data(data=data, key="pad_mode", default=DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING)
30	    dp_size = data["dp_size"]
31	    batch_num_tokens = data["batch_num_tokens"]
32	
33	    log_prob = model_output["log_probs"]
34	
35	    if pad_mode == DatasetPadMode.NO_PADDING:
36	        # log_prob and loss mask are nested tensors of shape [bsz, j1]
37	        # for each sample, loss mask shape is [1, prompt_length + response_length]
38	        loss_mask = data["loss_mask"]
39	
40	        log_prob_flatten = log_prob.values()
41	        loss_mask_flatten = loss_mask.values()
42	
43	        # left-shift the loss mask by one token to align with log_prob
44	        loss_mask_flatten = torch.roll(loss_mask_flatten, shifts=-1, dims=0)
45	
46	        # NOTE: loss is averaged over all tokens in the batch across all data parallel groups,
47	        # For FSDP backend, the loss is directly used for backward; while for Megatron backend,
48	        # the loss should be scaled by `num_microbatches` for pp schedule.
49	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob_flatten, loss_mask_flatten) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
50	    else:
51	        response_mask = data["response_mask"].to(bool)
52	        loss = -masked_sum(log_prob, response_mask) / batch_num_tokens * dp_size
53	
54	    return loss, {}

57	def ppo_loss(config: ActorConfig, model_output, data: TensorDict, dp_group=None):
58	    """Computes ppo loss from model output (log_prob, entropy, values, etc. ) and old_log_probs from data."""
59	    log_prob = no_padding_2_padding(model_output["log_probs"], data)
60	    entropy = model_output.get("entropy", None)
61	    if entropy is not None:
62	        entropy = no_padding_2_padding(entropy, data)
63	
64	    # global batch info for loss aggregation
65	    config.global_batch_info["dp_size"] = data["dp_size"]
66	    config.global_batch_info["batch_num_tokens"] = data["batch_num_tokens"]
67	    config.global_batch_info["global_batch_size"] = data["global_batch_size"]
68	    config.global_batch_info["loss_scale_factor"] = config.loss_scale_factor
69	
70	    # assumes that if any of the global batch info is set, the policy_loss_fn will
71	    # normalize using dp_size/global_bsz/global_token; in this case, metric aggregation should be SUM
72	    # to reflect the mean loss over the global batch
73	    if (
74	        data["dp_size"] > 1
75	        or data["batch_num_tokens"] is not None
76	        or data["global_batch_size"] is not None
77	        or config.loss_scale_factor is not None
78	    ):
79	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.SUM
80	    else:
81	        metric_aggregation = AggregationType.MEAN
82	
83	    metrics = {}
84	
85	    # select fields and convert to padded tensor
86	    fields = ["response_mask", "old_log_probs", "advantages"]
87	    if "rollout_is_weights" in data:
88	        fields.append("rollout_is_weights")
89	    if "ref_log_prob" in data:
90	        fields.append("ref_log_prob")
91	    data = data.select(*fields).to_padded_tensor()
92

94	    # compute policy loss

96	    advantages = data["advantages"]
97	    rollout_is_weights = data.get("rollout_is_weights", None)
98	
99	    loss_agg_mode = config.loss_agg_mode
100	
101	    loss_mode = config.policy_loss.get("loss_mode", "vanilla")
102	
103	    policy_loss_fn = get_policy_loss_fn(loss_mode)
104	    pg_loss, pg_metrics = policy_loss_fn(
105	        old_log_prob=old_log_prob,
106	        log_prob=log_prob,
107	        advantages=advantages,
108	        response_mask=response_mask,
109	        loss_agg_mode=loss_agg_mode,
110	        config=config,
111	        rollout_is_weights=rollout_is_weights,
112	    )
113	
114	    # AggregationType.MEAN for pg metrics: assumes policy_loss_fn normalizes by local_bsz/local_tokens
115	    # Ex: in compute_policy_loss_vanilla, pg_metrics are pg_clipfrac, ppo_kl, pg_clipfrac_lower
116	    pg_metrics = Metric.from_dict(pg_metrics, aggregation=AggregationType.MEAN)
117	
118	    metrics.update(pg_metrics)
119	    metrics["actor/pg_loss"] = Metric(value=pg_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)
120	    policy_loss = pg_loss

123	    if entropy is not None:

126	        )
127	        entropy_coeff = config.entropy_coeff
128	        policy_loss -= entropy_coeff * entropy_loss
129	        metrics["actor/entropy_loss"] = Metric(value=entropy_loss, aggregation=metric_aggregation)

133	        ref_log_prob = data["ref_log_prob"]
134	        # compute kl loss

498	            else:

1157	    def _balance_batch(self, batch: DataProto, metrics, logging_prefix="global_seqlen", keep_minibatch=False):
1158	        """Reorder the data on single controller such that each dp rank gets similar total tokens.
1159	
1160	        When use_prefix_grouper is enabled, uses group-level balancing to keep samples with
1161	        the same uid together on the same rank for prefix sharing optimization.
1162	        """
1163	        attention_mask = batch.batch["attention_mask"]
1164	        batch_size = attention_mask.shape[0]
1165	        global_seqlen_lst = batch.batch["attention_mask"].view(batch_size, -1).sum(-1)  # (train_batch_size,)
1166	        workload_lst = calculate_workload(global_seqlen_lst)
1167	        # Get dp_size from dispatch info to correctly balance across data parallel ranks
1168	        # Note: world_size may include tensor/pipeline parallel dimensions, but we only want DP
1169	        dp_size = self._get_dp_size(self.actor_rollout_wg, "actor")
1170	
1171	        # Use group-level balancing for PrefixGrouper to keep same-uid samples together
1172	        if getattr(self, "use_prefix_grouper", False) and "uid" in batch.non_tensor_batch:
1173	            from verl.utils.seqlen_balancing import get_group_balanced_partitions
1174	
1175	            uid_list = list(batch.non_tensor_batch["uid"])
1176	            seqlen_list = global_seqlen_lst.tolist()
1177	
1178	            # Count number of uid groups
1179	            num_groups = len(set(uid_list))
1180	
1181	            if num_groups % dp_size != 0:
1182	                raise ValueError(
1183	                    f"PrefixGrouper with balance_batch requires num_uid_groups ({num_groups}) "
1184	                    f"% dp_size ({dp_size}) == 0. "
1185	                    f"This ensures each rank gets equal number of groups. "
1186	                    f"Current batch_size={batch_size}, adjust batch_size to be a multiple of "
1187	                    f"dp_size * rollout.n."
1188	                )
1189	
1190	            global_partition_lst = get_group_balanced_partitions(
1191	                seqlen_list=seqlen_list,
1192	                uid_list=uid_list,
1193	                k_partitions=dp_size,
1194	            )
1195	
1196	        elif keep_minibatch:
1197	            # Decouple the DP balancing and mini-batching.
1198	            minibatch_size = self.config.actor_rollout_ref.actor.get("ppo_mini_batch_size")
1199	            minibatch_num = len(workload_lst) // minibatch_size
1200	            global_partition_lst = [[] for _ in range(dp_size)]
1201	            for i in range(minibatch_num):
1202	                rearrange_minibatch_lst = get_seqlen_balanced_partitions(
1203	                    workload_lst[i * minibatch_size : (i + 1) * minibatch_size],
1204	                    k_partitions=dp_size,
1205	                    equal_size=True,
1206	                )
1207	                for j, part in enumerate(rearrange_minibatch_lst):
1208	                    global_partition_lst[j].extend([x + minibatch_size * i for x in part])
1209	        else:
1210	            global_partition_lst = get_seqlen_balanced_partitions(workload_lst, k_partitions=dp_size, equal_size=True)
1211	        # Place smaller micro-batches at both ends to reduce the bubbles in pipeline parallel.
1212	        # Skip reordering within partitions for PrefixGrouper to maintain uid grouping
1213	        if not getattr(self, "use_prefix_grouper", False):
1214	            for idx, partition in enumerate(global_partition_lst):
1215	                partition.sort(key=lambda x: (workload_lst[x], x))
1216	                ordered_partition = partition[::2] + partition[1::2][::-1]
1217	                global_partition_lst[idx] = ordered_partition
1218	
1219	        # reorder based on index. The data will be automatically equally partitioned by dispatch function
1220	        global_idx = torch.tensor([j for partition in global_partition_lst for j in partition])
1221	        batch.reorder(global_idx)
1222	        global_balance_stats = log_seqlen_unbalance(
1223	            seqlen_list=global_seqlen_lst.tolist(), partitions=global_partition_lst, prefix=logging_prefix
1224	        )
1225	        metrics.update(global_balance_stats)
